description: Number of business days between two dates in a Canadian province or territory, excluding weekends and that province's statutory holidays (with weekend holidays moved to their observed weekday). Counts from the start date up to but not including the end date, and lists the holidays skipped. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

province.description: Two-letter Canadian province or territory code

to.description: Day after the last day counted, YYYY-MM-DD

name: canada_business_days
